acceptance: On the first recurrence, the #4285 evidence from that run is analysed and the first fault is named (backend stall, heartbeat timeout, memory pressure, network or provider) with log lines cited.
Decision gate: a fix that changes memory limits, blacklist or heartbeat settings, timeouts, retries or cell pruning needs explicit owner approval before it lands.

If no recurrence happens in 10 consecutive release or trunk UAT StarRocks shards with capture enabled, record each shard's run id and runner provider/image, including at least 3 on AWS-hosted runners, then ask the owner whether to close as not reproducible. Passes on Azure alone do not count.
Determine whether the readiness probe's 'Backend node not found' is expected startup noise or a real readiness gap; if real, make the probe wait for an alive, non-blacklisted backend.
context: 2026-11-19 evidence. Failures: rc1 release-v2 43782246418 attempts 1 to 3, on AWS-hosted runners (us-west-2, us-east-1, image 20261111.82.6).
